# Clavis Encrypt 3.12.0

## 🆕 Shred files and folders (Free)

- Remove files you no longer need for good: Clavis overwrites each file once with random data, then deletes it.
- **Right-click** any file or folder → **Clavis → Shred…**, or use the new **Shred Files** page in the sidebar (drag files onto it).
- Before anything happens you see every file that will be shredded and tick **"I understand this can't be undone."** Cancel is always the default.
- Clavis refuses to shred Windows and program folders, your user folder, whole drives and its own vault folder.
- After encrypting, a new **Clean up other copies…** link shows where leftover copies often hide (Downloads, Desktop, Recycle Bin, WhatsApp, cloud version history).
- Honest note: on SSDs, USB sticks and memory cards, and where backups or cloud version history keep copies, earlier versions of a file can survive. Encrypting is what protects a file.

## Also

- The sidebar scrolls when the window is short, so every item stays reachable.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now), or download the new installer from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.
- **Microsoft Store:** the Store updates it automatically. (The Store version has no right-click menu; use the Shred Files page.)
- **Linux:** install the new `.deb` from https://clavisenc.com/download.html.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
